predictions: Oh, man, what is it with last week's pairings?!?! I went 15-10 last week, which is my 2nd worst week of the season. Aaaaaand… the only week when I did worse was seven weeks prior when the exact same pairings were played!! And clearly, I don't learn - I got 7 of the 11 week 2 wrong picks wrong again! And of course, I picked Trips Are For Kids to win again, so they tanked on me… again. I did lose two in 1001s, and four more in the last 501, so at least I was close. 159-65 (71% correct) now.

Match of the week: (C Div.) Hump Day! @ Shooter McGavin. Three teams in C have run away from the pack, and McGavin still holds their one match lead because they pulled a 501 Houdini act last week. Now they embark on their own two-match string where they face both teams a match behind them. This race story is way more interesting if Hump Day levels the race with a win here. I like interesting. Hump it is, 13-11.

Match #2: (D Div.) Village Idiots @ Reload. This D race was supposed to be a three-team race like the C story above. But then the Rangers went and dumped one last week, and now we might well be left with just these two. Reload is one ahead in the loss column and has a big point lead, so if the Idiots win, they'll still need help. Reload gets payback in 1001.

Match #3: (E Div.) Liquor Possee @ Death Throw. Nope, Death Throw isn't going to catch Possee in the E title chase. But Death Throw was the team that absolutely torched the Possee's title competitor just last week. So will Possee meet the same fate as Dart Side, or do they take the next big step toward the crown? Possee, but it will be tight. 13-11.

Match #4: (D Div.) Red-eye Rangers @ DD-214. The Rangers fell hard to the Machine last week, and DD needed a tiebreaker to outlast winless She-Unit. To say these are teams not rolling in here on a hot streak would be a bit of an understatement. Not really sure what to expect, but since DD has only surpassed 12 twice all season… it's Rangers, 13-11.

Match #5: (B Div.) Inconsistently Consistent @ Double In, Stumble Out. Consistent has been exactly that… Consistently somehow just missing out on win after win. They scored 8-12 points every week after opening night. But they're still so very dangerous. Stumble Out had better not sleep here, or they could lose hold of 2nd. Stumble, 13-11.

Match #6: (G Div.) The Neighborhood Dart Knights @ Killer Dee's. The Dee's rang up a huge win last week, and are clearly focused on getting past Bottoms Up the newly revamped Vader's to reel in 2nd. The Dart Knights can beat anyone in G, but this is still Dee's, 14-10.

Match #7: (B Div.) One Armed Bandits @ Raging Bulls Eyes. There are FOUR teams in B at 3-6, and all four of them have more points than the lone 4-5 squad. The race to avoid bottom-two finishes is in full swing. Back-to-back Raging wins? Sure, 13-11.

Match #8: (E Div.) Bangin The Wire @ Cheap Shots. If the Ducks keep up their last three weeks' run, these two could be in danger of falling to a bottom-two spot if they lose this one. Bangin gets their ninth consecutive score in the 11-14 range, to the good side. 13-11.
Match #9: (B Div.) Trips Are For Kids @ Put It on Matt's Tab. Do I think Matt's Tab is more consistent? Yep. Am I picking For Kids anyway, just to make them lose to prove me wrong? Indeed, I am.
Match #10: (A Div.) Darty Minds @ 2 Liver Die With LA. Liver's armor finally yielded to some cracks last week, after they were on the edge a lot of times previously. Another loss here? Nah. 15-9.
Match #11: (E Div.) Duck Around & Find Out @ Runs with Corks. The Ducks came through in 1001 last week, while Cork listed oddly and fell in a 1001 that likely ended title hopes. Corks rebound, 15-9.
Match #12: (C Div.) The Outlaws @ Menace 2 Sobriety. One of Menace's last shots at a win this season? Alas, it's Outlaws, 14-10.
